fields.Name: Referrals.MatchProfessionals
fields.Description: Matches and ranks verified professionals for a referral request using multi-factor scoring and conflict screening.

fields.Name: Referrals.RouteReferral
fields.Description: Routes a referral request through sequential SLA-backed cascade offers.

fields.Name: Referrals.RespondToReferral
fields.Description: Processes a professional accept, decline, or conflict rejection on a referral assignment.

fields.Name: Referrals.SweepExpiredReferralSLAs
fields.Description: Sweeps expired SLA referral offers and cascades to the next eligible professional.
